subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should structured usage become an additive part of `session_status.details`, or should OpenClaw introduce a separate read-only agent usage tool?
rationale: The underlying data exists, but the choice defines a durable agent tool contract, permission boundary, latency profile, and freshness semantics that cannot be selected safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Extend session_status details
options.body: Add typed usage fields while retaining the existing rendered status card and visibility behavior.

options.title: Create a separate usage tool
options.body: Keep `session_status` display-focused and expose structured usage through a dedicated schema and access policy.

recommendation.title: Extend session_status details
recommendation.body: Add typed usage fields while retaining the existing rendered status card and visibility behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined signal from the prior product review and recent history across the relevant status and usage surfaces.
